decision.observation: 5 mph, gear 1, timer 43:02.720, red X lit, dots pale. The camera has pulled back; the car is still on grass roughly 2-3 car widths right of the gravel's edge, with a pine trunk just left of the nose and the road curving up-frame to the left.
decision.hypothesis: The short A beat only nudged the heading; the car is running parallel to the road rather than converging on it. A longer low-speed W+A hold should actually turn the nose left onto the gravel before speed climbs into the stall range.
decision.memory: At 5-7 mph on this grass strip the 0.5-0.7 s A beats are too short to close a 2-3 car width gap; longer holds (~1 s) were what finally centred the car on grass strips earlier.
